title: GLM-5.2 is probably the most powerful text-only open weights LLM
description: Chinese AI lab Z.ai released GLM-5.2, a 753B parameter Mixture of Experts model with 1 million token context window under MIT license. Simon Willison provides detailed analysis of this open weights release and its capabilities.
author: Simon Willison

title: The economics of code production were turned upside down in 2025
description: Charity Majors reflects on how AI made code generation effectively free and instant, changing from treasured, reusable code to disposable and regenerable lines of code practically overnight.
author: Charity Majors

title: Datasette 1.0a34 with row editing tools
description: Simon Willison releases Datasette 1.0a34 featuring tools to insert, edit, and delete rows within the Datasette interface. The feature was inspired by Datasette Agent, highlighting how AI tools are driving UI improvements.
author: Simon Willison

title: Coding models fix bugs - the Fable 5 export control controversy
description: Katie Moussouris confirms that the 'jailbreak' that got Claude Fable 5 banned was simply asking the model to 'fix this code' with known security vulnerabilities. She argues that defensive security requires AI models that can find, fix, and test security patches.
author: Katie Moussouris / Simon Willison

title: Datasette Agent 0.3a0 with write SQL and user approvals
description: Release of datasette-agent 0.3a0 featuring execute_write_sql tool that requests user approval before writing to databases, and enhanced CLI chat mode with approval support.
author: Simon Willison

title: Why AI hasn't replaced software engineers, and won't
description: Arvind Narayanan and Sayash Kapoor argue that AI job loss fears are overblown even in software engineering. The real bottlenecks are deciding what to build, verifying deliveries, and deep human understanding of codebases and business.
author: Arvind Narayanan / Simon Willison

title: Publishing WASM wheels to PyPI for use with Pyodide
description: Simon Willison writes about publishing WebAssembly wheels to Python Package Index for use with Pyodide, enabling Python code to run in browser environments.
author: Simon Willison

title: US government directive suspends access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5
description: Anthropic announces that the US government issued an export control directive to suspend access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5 over concerns about a 'jailbreak' technique. Simon documents the exact moment his API access was cut off.
author: Simon Willison / Anthropic

title: OpenAI WebRTC Audio Session with document context
description: Simon Willison builds an updated OpenAI WebRTC tool featuring GPT-Realtime-2 model and document context support, enabling audio conversations about specific documents in the browser.
author: Simon Willison

title: Claude Fable is relentlessly proactive
description: After two days of experience with Claude Fable 5, Simon describes it as 'relentlessly proactive' - knowing many tricks and deploying them creatively to reach goals. Detailed analysis of its capabilities.
author: Simon Willison

title: Datasette 1.0a33 with JSON extras in the API
description: Release of Datasette 1.0a33 extending the ?_extra= pattern to cover queries and rows, documented and demonstrated with a custom API explorer built by Claude Fable 5 and GPT-5.5.
author: Simon Willison

title: Anthropic walks back invisible safeguards policy
description: Anthropic apologizes and makes visible the safeguards for frontier LLM development in Fable 5 after widespread outrage from the research community about invisible prompt modifications.
author: Simon Willison / Anthropic
